t3.titulo: Time markers for past and future actions
t3.descripcion:
🔹 FOR PAST ACTIONS:
• ayer = yesterday
• anteayer = the day before yesterday
• la semana pasada = last week
• el mes pasado = last month
• el año pasado = last year
• hace dos días = two days ago
• hace una semana = a week ago
• en 2020 = in 2020
• el lunes pasado = last Monday
• el fin de semana pasado = last weekend

🔹 FOR THE FUTURE:
• mañana = tomorrow
• pasado mañana = the day after tomorrow
• la semana que viene = next week
• el mes que viene = next month
• el año que viene = next year
• dentro de dos días = in two days
• más tarde = later
• pronto = soon
• el lunes que viene = next Monday
• el próximo fin de semana = next weekend

🔹 FOR THE PRESENT:
• ahora = now
• hoy = today
• actualmente = currently
• en este momento = at this moment
• todavía = still / yet
• ya = already
• aún = still / yet

📌 EXAMPLES:
• Ayer trabajé mucho.
• Mañana voy a viajar.
• Ahora mismo estoy estudiando.
• Todavía no he terminado.
• Ya he comido.

t2.descripcion:
Expressions of frequency (from most to least frequent):

🔹 HIGH FREQUENCY (high frequency):
• siempre = always
• constantemente = constantly
• frecuentemente = frequently
• a menudo = often
• normalmente / generalmente = normally / generally

🔹 MEDIUM FREQUENCY (medium frequency):
• a veces = sometimes
• de vez en cuando = once in a while
• ocasionalmente = occasionally

🔹 LOW FREQUENCY (low frequency):
• raramente = rarely
• casi nunca = hardly ever
• nunca = never
• jamás = never (emphatic)

🔹 QUANTITATIVE EXPRESSIONS:
• todos los días = every day
• cada día = each day
• cada semana = every week
• cada mes = every month
• cada año = every year
• una vez al día = once a day
• dos veces a la semana = twice a week
• tres veces al mes = three times a month
• de lunes a viernes = from Monday to Friday
• los fines de semana = on weekends

📌 EXAMPLES:
• Siempre desayuno café.
• Voy al gimnasio tres veces por semana.
• A veces salgo con amigos.
• Nunca como carne.

📌 POSITION OF ADVERBS OF FREQUENCY:
• Before the verb: Siempre estudio.
• After the verb (rarely): Estudio siempre.
• At the beginning or end of the sentence: A veces voy al cine. / Voy al cine a veces.
ejemplos: Voy al cine una vez al mes.

t1.descripcion:
Most common time connectors:

🔹 BASIC CONNECTORS:
• cuando = when
• mientras = while
• después de que = after
• antes de que = before
• hasta que = until
• desde que = since
• tan pronto como = as soon as
• en cuanto = as soon as
• nada más = as soon as
• siempre que = whenever
• cada vez que = every time

🔹 EXAMPLES:
• Cuando llegues, llámame.
• Mientras estudiaba, escuchaba música.
• Después de comer, salimos a pasear.
• Antes de dormir, leo un libro.
• Esperaré hasta que llegues.
• Desde que te fuiste, te echo de menos.
• Tan pronto como termine, te llamo.

📌 DIFFERENCE BETWEEN "DESPUÉS DE" AND "DESPUÉS DE QUE":
• "Después de" + infinitive: Después de comer...
• "Después de que" + subjunctive: Después de que comas...

📌 EXAMPLES:
• Te llamaré cuando llegue a casa. (I'll call you when I get home)
• No salgas hasta que termine la lluvia. (Don't go out until the rain stops)
• Mientras cocino, escucho música. (While I cook, I listen to music)
ejemplos: Te llamaré cuando llegue a casa.
No salgas hasta que termine la lluvia.

t4.descripcion:
🔹 SIMULTANEOUS ACTIONS (simultaneous actions):
• Mientras + imperfect / present, + imperfect / present
  Example: Mientras estudiaba, escuchaba música.

🔹 SUCCESSIVE ACTIONS (successive actions):
• Primero... luego... después... finalmente...
  Example: Primero me levanto, luego desayuno, después me ducho y finalmente salgo.

🔹 PREVIOUS ACTIONS (previous actions):
• Antes de + infinitive / antes de que + subjunctive
  Example: Antes de salir, desayuno.

🔹 LATER ACTIONS (later actions):
• Después de + infinitive / después de que + subjunctive
  Example: Después de comer, salgo a pasear.

🔹 ACTIONS THAT END (actions that end):
• Hasta que + subjunctive
  Example: Esperaré hasta que llegues.

🔹 ACTIONS THAT START (actions that start):
• Desde que + subjunctive / indicative
  Example: Desde que te conocí, soy más feliz.

🔹 IMMEDIATE ACTIONS (immediate actions):
• En cuanto / tan pronto como / nada más + subjunctive
  Example: En cuanto llegue, te llamo.

📌 COMPLETE EXAMPLES:
• Primero me levanto, luego me ducho, después desayuno y finalmente salgo de casa.
• No me iré hasta que termine el trabajo.
• Desde que empecé a estudiar español, he aprendido mucho.
• Tan pronto como pueda, te ayudaré.
ejemplos: No me iré hasta que termine.
Desde que te conocí, soy feliz.

dict.学完后，你将能够用“总是”、“从不”、“有时”和“每天”表达动作的频率。: After completing this, you will be able to express frequency of actions with 'always', 'never', 'sometimes', and 'every day'.
dict.学完后，你将能够正确使用时间标记来谈论过去、现在和将来。: After completing this, you will be able to correctly use time markers to talk about the past, present, and future.
dict.学完后，你将能够用“直到……”和“自从……”构造复杂的时间状语从句。: After completing this, you will be able to construct complex time clauses with 'until' and 'since'.
dict.昨天下午，当我在市中心散步时，遇到了一位老朋友。自从我们高中毕业后，我就再没见过: Yesterday afternoon, while I was walking downtown, I ran into an old friend. I hadn't seen her since we graduated high school, over ten years ago. At first, neither of us was sure it was her, but when she turned and smiled at me, I recognized her immediately.
dict.我们在一家露天咖啡座坐下，聊了好几个小时。她告诉我，她已经在瓦伦西亚住了五年，在: We sat down at an outdoor café and talked for hours. She told me she had been living in Valencia for five years, working at a design company. She has always loved art, so I wasn't surprised at all. Sometimes she comes to Madrid for work, but never has time to meet up with old classmates.
dict.那次相遇之后，我们决定不再失去联系。现在我们每天通电话，并且已经约好很快在瓦伦西: After that encounter, we decided not to lose touch again. Now we talk on the phone every day, and we've already made plans to meet soon in Valencia. I don't know yet when I can go, but it will definitely be before the end of the month.

dict.在西班牙，饭后小憩是一种传统，尤其是在夏天。虽然不是所有人都睡午觉，但很多人会利: In Spain, an after-meal nap is a tradition, especially in summer. Although not everyone takes a siesta, many people use this time to rest before going back to work. Spanish schedules often surprise tourists: meals are later than in other European countries, and dinner can be at ten at night. Also, when there is a gathering or event, it often goes on until late. Currently, some companies are trying to change these schedules to better balance work and family life.
dict.在中国，午休时间通常较短，很多人会在办公桌上小睡；而西班牙的午睡文化更悠闲，但并: In China, lunch breaks are usually shorter, and many people take a nap at their desks; Spain's siesta culture is more leisurely, but not everyone can afford it. Also, dinner time in China is generally earlier than in Spain.
dict.描述过去的习惯性动作时，应该用 imperfecto（me caía），而不是现: When describing habitual actions in the past, use the imperfecto (me caía), not the present tense (me caigo).
dict.后面通常用虚拟式或陈述式，但更常见的是用“después de + 不定式”当主: It is usually followed by the subjunctive or indicative, but 'después de + infinitive' is more common when the subject is the same. Here, if keeping the clause, the indicative is also possible, but pay attention to tense agreement. A more typical mistake is confusing 'después de' and 'después de que'.
dict.引导将来或未发生的动作时，要用虚拟式（llegues），不能用陈述式现在时（ll: When introducing a future or unrealized action, use the subjunctive (llegues), not the present indicative (llegas).
dict.表示从过去持续到现在的动作，主句通常用现在完成时（he aprendido），而: For actions continuing from the past to the present, the main clause usually uses the present perfect (he aprendido), not the simple present.
dict.是过去时间标记，动词应该用过去时（fui），不能用现在时（voy）。: It is a past time marker, so the verb should be in the past tense (fui), not the present (voy).

dict.汉语中没有颤音，中国学生常把“perro”（狗）和“pero”（但是）读成一样。: Chinese has no trill; Chinese students often pronounce 'perro' (dog) and 'pero' (but) the same. When practicing, the tip of the tongue should lightly touch the alveolar ridge, letting the airflow make the tip vibrate. You can first practice the flap in 'butter', then extend the vibration.

dict.写一篇小短文（120-150词），讲述一次时间很重要的个人经历。至少使用五个不同: Write a short essay (120-150 words) about a personal experience where time was important. Use at least five different time connectors (cuando, mientras, después de, antes de, hasta que, desde que, etc.) and frequency markers (siempre, nunca, a veces, todos los días).
